sentences.text: This 2nd bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by petitioner in connection with FIR No.152/2022 registered with Police Station Lakheri District Bundi wherein the petitioner is charged for the offences under Section 376-D of IPC (later on for the offences under Sections 366 and 376 (2) (n) of IPC).

Perusal of the earlier order dated 07.12.2022 passed by this Court indicates that the first bail application filed by the petitioner was dismissed as withdrawn granting liberty to the petitioner to renew his prayer for bail after recording the statement of the prosecutrix.
Now the statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded and the petitioner has filed this bail application.

sentences.text: /RJJP/003218] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-2385/2023] Perusal of the instant bail application indicates that the prosecutrix has not supported the case of prosecution and she has turned hostile.
However, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Perusal of the record indicates that during the course of trial, statements of the prosecutrix have been recorded and she has not supported the case of prosecution and she has turned hostile.
The petitioner is in custody since the date of his arrest and the trial will take its own time to conclude.

Without expressing any opinion on merits and demerits of the case, I deem it just and appropriate to grant indulgence of bail to the petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this 2nd bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that accused-petitioner Satyanarayan Son of Mathura Lal arrested in connection with aforementioned FIR, may be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with two surety bonds of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial Court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(ANOOP KUMAR DHAND),J MR/8 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
